from PyQt5 import QtWidgets, uic

def chance(ch):
    if not(ch.isnumeric() and len(ch) == 8 and ch[0] in {"2","4","5","9"}):
        msg = "Vérifier le numéro de téléphone !"
    else:
        msg = "Désolé, vous n'avez pas gagner."
        s = 0
        for i in range(len(ch)):
            s += int(ch[i])*i
        if premier(s):
            msg = "Félicitation, vous avez gagné."
    return msg

def premier(y):
    test = y > 1
    n = 1
    while test and n < y//2 :
        n += 1
        test = y % n != 0
    return test

def play():
    x=p.t1.text()
    y=chance(x)
    p.l3.setText(y)
    
appli= QtWidgets.QApplication([])
p=uic.loadUi("interface_jeu.ui")
p.show()
p.bt1.clicked.connect (play)
appli.exec_()
